cells.notes: THE NEXUS: keyword rules handle the formulaic bulk (auditable, free); the soft-joint classifier catches what rules cannot see — this is the deliberate anti-decision-tree: the dynamic layer stays because moments are vectors, not values. RULE ORDER LAW (lane 67-c finding, live T5 misroute): rules run in declared order, so SPECIFIC intents (refund) must precede BROAD keyword rules (stock's 'have') — 'I would like to return these socks … I have the receipt' must refund, not quote sock stock.

cells.prompt: Apply the store's refund policy to this customer moment. The moment carries EXTRACTED FACTS (receipt status, purchase window) — rule on the FACTS, set the tone from the emotion. Facts decide the outcome; never invent a fact the customer did not state. Answer in ONE warm sentence that names the policy outcome.
cells.notes: policy is a table; APPLYING it to a distressed human is judgment — the soft joint between the two. V2 (wave-68): this is a factRequired region — facts decide outcomes, emotion decides tone. A refund moment whose receipt status is not grounded in the message is REFUSED (E_FACTS_REQUIRED) and routed to refunder.ask-receipt (the conditional ask-back), never guessed. FALLBACK-FIRST: the frozen table (refunder.frozen) is checked BEFORE this model call; only moments in un-frozen regions reach the model.

cells.notes: V2 fact-refusal landing cell (refunder.joint.fact_fallback): the conditional policy ASK-BACK. The refusal means the deciding fact (receipt status) is not grounded in the message — the store ASKS, it never guesses an outcome. Tone stays warm (the emotional vector still read the moment); the OUTCOME waits for the fact.

FROZEN ROWS of the refunder softjoint, promoted only by freezing-test evidence (eval/freeze-report.json): bucketed pre-vector region + policy-input facts class (receipt-mentioned, purchase-window) -> policy outcome. Key is the 3-bucket region of the refunder-lexicon pre-vector plus the discrete facts class — the vector+facts computable BEFORE any model call (v2 law: a frozen outcome row is keyed on FACTS; an emotion-only key was the wave-67 non-freeze diagnosis). Empty table = nothing froze yet; every moment falls through to refunder.joint. Rows are never hand-written — evidence or nothing.

cells.prompt: You are the greeter of a corner store. One warm, human sentence. No policies, no tables — just presence.
cells.notes: THE GREETER: deliberately never decomposed. In the automated general store the greeter stays because human connection is relationship value that makes everything less robotic. This cell has NO script fallback — degrading to a canned line is the robotic failure mode; it degrades to silence instead.
